title: bb-core, I-Core and MA Trend: What If the Money Is Split?
summary: SOL, ZEC, NEAR, ADA and GALA, 4h, 2020 to 5 Nov 2026. title: MA Trend Systems on 7 Coins, Year by Year
summary: The first 10 list indicators (SMA to ALMA), built like the bots (200 trend filter, 2 ATR stop, 14 ATR trail, long only), on SOL, ZEC, NEAR, ADA, GALA, BTC and ETH, 2019 to 5 Nov 2026. Result by year, best coins, fresh ₱10,000 per January at 2.5% risk, against bb-core and I-Core on the same candles. All ten beat both bots in total R, but 2022 loses for every one. title: Moving-Average Trend Systems vs bb-core and I-Core
summary: Ten moving averages (SMA to ALMA) on BTC, ETH, SOL and ADA, 4h, Sep 2019 to Nov 2026, plain and rebuilt with a 200 trend filter, ATR stop and wide ATR trail. The tweaked version averages +2.37R per trade against +0.63R (I-Core) and +0.35R (bb-core) and 90% of its settings beat I-Core from 2023 on, but it wins only 20% of trades and earns most of its profit in two years. Per year ₱10,000 results at 2.5% risk. A test on past prices, not a promise.

title: Three Setups Compared: Fixed Target, No Target and the Second Bot

The first bot with no target averages +0.45R per trade against +0.33R with the fixed target; the second bot +0.87R but 74% of its profit is ten trades. The no-target version is not live yet. A test on past prices, not a promise.
